message: The template '{0}' cannot be referenced from the template '{1}' because it is not a method. A template can only call other templates that are methods.
rationale: The current wording 'because it is a template, but not a method' is awkward and gives no way forward; the report site in TemplateAnnotator.VisitIdentifierName fires for any non-method [Template] member (property, field, event) referenced from a template, and the fix is to turn it into a template method.
